{{Quote|I think we've got something, sir. The report is only a fragment from a probe droid in the Hoth system, but it's the best lead we've had.''"<br />"''We have thousands of probe droids searching the galaxy. I want proof, not leads!|Captain Firmus Piett and Admiral Kendal Ozzel, in the Qeimet system|audio=PiettOzzelBestLead-TESB.flac|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''Qeimet system''' was a [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] lying on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]]. It served as headquarters for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Sarin Oversector]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the system shared its name with the Imperial [[Qeimet fleet]], which [[Hook Nebula campaign|fought]] against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|forces]] in the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]]. Qeimet was also the site where several [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]] were accidentally leaked to the [[Media/Legends|media]], resulting in the name of the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]], the governing body of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], becoming public knowledge.

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] was rendezvousing in the Qeimet system when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] informed his [[Commanding officer/Legends|superior]], [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], of the findings of an Imperial [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] in the supposedly uninhabited [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. Piett argued that the probe's discovery indicated the presence of a hidden [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Rebel base]], but Ozzel dismissed the captain's reports. However, the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral's]] objections were overruled by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who was confident that they had indeed found the [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel base]] and promptly ordered the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to travel to the [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] system.

==Description==
The Qeimet [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located within the [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]], which connected it to the [[Trigalis system/Legends|Trigalis]] and [[Lybeya system/Legends|Vergesso systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> A large [[Color/Legends|pink]]-and-yellow [[Nebula/Legends|nebulosity]] was visible from within the system.<ref name="TESBRemastered">[[Star Wars (1977) 39|''Star Wars'' (1977) 39]] {{Crp}}</ref>

==History==
===The Sarin Oversector===
[[File:SarinOversector.png|thumb|right|250px|The Qeimet system served as headquarters for Moff Kintaro of the Sarin Oversector.]]
The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Qeimet system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> When the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Qeimet system served as base of operations for the [[Fifteenth Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. The Fifteenth Army was tasked with defending the territory known as the [[Sarin Oversector]] against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy.<ref name="TEGTW" />

By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Moff date">The passing of the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]], which, according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', established the system of regional [[Governor/Legends|governors]] known as [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], is mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]], the events of which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Qeimet served as the headquarters of Republic [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kintaro]] of the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin]] [[Oversector/Legends|Oversector]]. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kintaro became the [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Sarin Oversector,<ref name="TEGTW" /> though he relocated his headquarters to [[Talofan]],<ref name="SOTES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> in the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]],<ref name="EAOC Talofan">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Talofan system/Legends|Talofan system]]</ref> by [[3 ABY|3.5 ABY]].<ref name="SOTE Date">The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' describes events of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY|3.5 ABY]].</ref>

===Under the Empire===
{{Quote|On many worlds, 'Ubiqtorate' has come to be the name for the whole of Imperial Intelligence. The name came to light in several COMPNOR scandocs which were accidentally transmitted to a media beamcast in the Qeimat system.|An Imperial Security Bureau report|<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the Empire, several [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]] [[Author/Legends|authored]] by the Imperial [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] were accidentally [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitted]] to a [[Media/Legends|media]] [[beamcast]] located in the Qeimet system. The leaked scandocs mentioned the name of the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]], the governing body of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], although the documents did not reveal the true role of the former within the latter, and Intelligence therefore did not attempt to correct the error. As a result of the beamcast, the general public first learned of the Ubiqtorate, and in popular opinion the terms "Ubiqtorate" and "Imperial Intelligence" became synonymous. Also during the Imperial reign, the Qeimet system was the namesake of the Imperial [[Qeimet fleet]], which was based near the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]] and tasked with [[Hook Nebula campaign|eliminating]] the [[Alliance Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] within the nebula.<ref name="ISB2" />

The Qeimet system was depicted on a map of the Imperial territorial oversector 15,<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> corresponding to the Republic's Sarin Oversector,<ref name="TEGTW" /> within ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] manual published [[0 BBY/Legends|nineteen years after]] the formation of the Empire.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] mentioned the Qeimet beamcast incident in a report prepared for the [[ISB Central Office/Legends|ISB Central Office]], which in turn was added by Rebel Alliance [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] to a compilation of Imperial documents for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="ISB2" />

===Discovery of the Rebel base===
{{Quote|That's it. The Rebels are there.''"<br />"''My lord, there are so many uncharted settlements. It could be smugglers, it could be&hellip;''"<br />"''That is the system. And I'm sure Skywalker is with them. Set your course for the Hoth system.|Darth Vader and Admiral Kendal Ozzel, in the Qeimet system|audio=VaderAndOzzel-HothSystem.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:ExecutorAndFriends-SW39ALTA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Imperial Death Squadron was present in the Qeimet system at the time of its discovery of the Rebel base on Hoth.]]
In 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] discovery of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], the personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of<ref name="TEGTW" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> rendezvoused<ref name="ESB junior">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> in the Qeimet system.<ref name="Qeimet retcon">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' designates the Qeimet [[Star system/Legends|system]] as the location from where [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] begins its travel toward the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at the beginning of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. In ''The Empire Strikes Back'', the origin point of that journey corresponds to the deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] location where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] learns of the location of the [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden Rebel base]] and orders his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to travel to the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].</ref> Tasked with locating the hidden [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Rebel base]],<ref name="TEGTW" /> the fleet waited in the system to receive any leads on its whereabouts.<ref name="TESBRemastered" />

While there, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] of the<ref name="FF89">{{FactFile|89|PIE 3-6|Admiral Firmus Piett}}</ref> [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the fleet,<ref name="CSWE Executor">{{CSWECite|I|245|''Executor''}}</ref> informed [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] of a fragmentary report transmitted by a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] from the supposedly uninhabited [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. One of thousands dispatched by the Empire to locate the [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel base]], the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe's]] findings indicated life readings, which Piett believed signaled the presence of the hidden base, but Ozzel was dismissive of the possibility.<ref name="ESB" />

Meanwhile, Vader, who had been observing the fleet's movements through the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge's]] [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]], approached the two arguing [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]]. Taking a look at the probe's transmission, Vader immediately expressed his confidence that the Empire had indeed discovered the site of the Rebel base. Overriding Ozzel's counterarguments, Vader ordered Death Squadron to set course for the Hoth system.<ref name="ESB" /> The fleet then jumped along the Five Veils Route to the [[Farstine system/Legends|Farstine system]], from where it continued its travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
The population of the Qeimet system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered from 10 million to 100 million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Notable appearances===
The Qeimet system was first mentioned in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', a [[1989]] supplement written by [[Greg Gorden]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]], placed the Qeimet system in the [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' instead placed the system in grid square P-17, outside of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="TEA" /> in which the Shwuy [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was later placed.<ref name="EAOC" />

[[File:DeathSquadronQeimatHoth-TEA.png|thumb|right|300px|''The Essential Atlas'' retconned the Qeimet system (spelled as "Qeimat" on the map) as appearing in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.]]
''The Essential Atlas'' [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively established]] the Qeimet system as the location where in<ref name="TEA" /> the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film,<ref name="ESB" /> [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader learns of the location of the Rebel base and orders his Star Destroyer fleet to travel to the Hoth system to engage the Rebel forces.<ref name="TEA" /> This scene first introduced Vader's [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|flagship]],<ref name="ESB" /> the ''Executor'',<ref name="TEA" /> as well as his character's recurring musical theme, "[[The Imperial March]]."<ref name="ESB soundtrack">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back Original Soundtrack|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'' Original Soundtrack]]</ref>

In addition, the [[2000]] ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], which focused on the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Chimaera}}</ref> from the [[1983]] sequel of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> used a modified version<ref name="CCG" /> of a still from the 1980 film depicting the Qeimet system<ref name="ESB" /> to depict the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].<ref name="CCG" /> While two panels in the<ref name="EpicCollection">{{StoryCite|story=Star Wars (1977) 39|sformatted=The Empire Strikes Back|book=Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: The Original Marvel Years Vol. 3}}</ref> [[June 3]], 1980<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars (1977) 39|thirty-ninth issue]] of the [[Marvel Comics]]' [[1977]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series depicted the Qeimet system as containing several celestial bodies of various colors,<ref name="EpicCollection" /> the remastered version of those same panels, as included in the<ref name="TESBRemastered" /> [[August 12]], [[2015]]<ref name="TESBRemasteredMarvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/collection/52704/star_wars_episode_v_-_the_empire_strikes_back_hc_hardcover|text=STAR WARS: EPISODE V - THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK HC (Hardcover)}}</ref> hardcover comic compilation [[Star Wars: Episode V — The Empire Strikes Back (hardcover)|''Star Wars: Episode V — The Empire Strikes Back'']], no longer depicted those astronomical objects as part of the star system.<ref name="TESBRemastered" />

In ''Imperial Sourcebook'', the system was introduced as "Qeimat system" alongside several mentions of the "Qeimet fleet."<ref name="ISB" /> Later sources repeated the "Qeimat" spelling for the system's name,<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="ISB2" /><ref name="Twinkle" /><ref name="CSWE Qeimat">{{CSWECite|III|54|Qeimat system}}</ref> while the [[1997]] article "[[Special Military Unit Intelligence Update]]," published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15]], also referred to the Qeimet fleet as "Qeimat fleet."<ref name="Special Military Unit Intelligence Update">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref> In [[2010]], [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', stated on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] on [[TheForce.net]] that "Qeimat" was considered a misspelled version of the system's name,<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31298680|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-10-10|time=8:39 PM|archivedate=20180219145450|quote=Qeimat looks like a misspelling. Will propose fix in next appendix.}}</ref> and the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' corrected the name to "Qeimet,"<ref name="EAOC" /> which is the only spelling used in later sources referring to the system.<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

===''The Empire Strikes Out''===
The [[2012]] non-canon animated short film ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Out]]'' depicts the ''Executor'' as being present within the Qeimet system along with a trio of other Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyers]], while a deep-space [[Navigation buoy/Legends|buoy]] that is also in the system supports a sign that reads, in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]], "MERGE WITH OVERHEAD TRAFFIC." A wildly spinning [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] is shown to bump into the sign on its out-of-control trajectory toward the ''Executor''.<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Out]]''</ref>
